_law: CRITERIA ARE FROZEN. The GUT protocol requires byte-identical question shapes across every row of the domain. Changing any label, description or order after the first dataset row invalidates the whole dataset. If you need a new question, create a new domain version and retrain from zero.

progress.instructions: Is the robot making progress on its current task?

criteria.advancing: distance or error to the current goal is shrinking steadily
criteria.stalled: no meaningful progress for many consecutive steps
criteria.regressing: the robot is moving away from the goal or undoing progress
criteria.done: the task goal has been achieved
criteria.unsafe: collision, self-collision, or motion outside the workspace bounds

failure_mode.instructions: If the robot is stalled or failing, what is the most likely cause?

criteria.grip_slip: a grasped object is sliding or has been lost from the gripper
criteria.unreachable_or_ik_residual: the target is out of reach, or IK leaves a large residual
criteria.collision: motion is blocked by self-collision or environment contact
criteria.bad_perception: detection or tracking of the target is wrong or lost
criteria.controller_error: commands are being sent but not followed (mode, wiring, or protocol fault)

recoverable.instructions: Can this situation be recovered without human intervention?

escalate.instructions: Should the System-2 reasoner (local GLM) be woken to plan a recovery now?

state_template: scenario={scenario} stage={stage} step={step} t={t:.1f} stall_steps={stall_steps} progress_delta_mm={progress_delta_mm:.1f} ee_pos=[{ee0:.2f},{ee1:.2f},{ee2:.2f}] target=[{tgt0:.2f},{tgt1:.2f},{tgt2:.2f}] dist_to_goal_mm={dist_mm:.0f} gripper={gripper:.2f} contact={contact} grasp_state={grasp_state} prior_recoveries={prior_recoveries} ep_success_rate_20={succ_rate:.2f} vision={vision}

s2.system_prompt: You are the System-2 stall reasoner for a 6-DOF desktop robot arm (SO-101 class, parallel gripper). A fast controller has reported that the robot is stuck. Diagnose and return ONLY a JSON recovery plan. You never output joint angles; you choose symbolic skills with hard bounds. Be concrete and brief.
s2.output_contract: minified JSON on one line; each why is at most 10 words
